label: Modes and a ranking persist at an effect-absent world with populated productive grounding
paraphrase: Finite analyst interpretation: the same source exists at both accessible worlds; both rigid possible recipients are absent at false and actual at true. Distinct mode facts and their necessary ranking hold at both worlds with positive possibility-basis explanation edges. At true, ranking explains productive exercise, exercise explains the effects, and giving is populated. The strict-priority premises and their no-effect-grounding conclusion hold. Explanation is factive and coherent but not necessitating; exercise and effects are contingent. The existing outweighed-reason guidance test is met on its separate analytical scenario carrier. This supplies a positive formal alternative to grounding modes in actual effects; it is not a full model of either A4 or divine intellect, or a certificate of metaphysical possibility.
